name: Image to Base64 Converter
desc: Turn an image into a Base64 data URI for HTML and CSS
seoDescription: Convert images to Base64 online. Get a data URI, an HTML img tag or CSS background code ready to copy. Free and private: nothing is uploaded.
intro: Embed small images directly in your HTML, CSS or JSON by turning them into Base64 text. Drop an image and copy the data URI, a ready-made img tag, or CSS background code.
steps: Drop one or more images into the box.
Choose what to copy: the data URI, an HTML img tag, CSS, or the Base64 text alone.

faq.q: When should I use Base64 images?
faq.a: They suit small icons and logos because they save a network request. For larger photos, normal image files are better because Base64 adds about 33 percent to the size.
